product_metadata.title: Jaccard 201506 Heavy Duty Aluminum Grill & Oven Bag, Large, Aluminum Foil Bag, Grill Bag, Cooking Bag
features: Aluminum Foil Bag: The single bag in the world with a self-venting window Constructed of FDA approved food grade polyester film
Cooking Bag: The foil bag maintains seal at low temperatures, and vents excess steam during cooking.
Easy to Use: Peel away the window and serve directly from the foil bag. The aluminum foil bag is ideal for single dish or complete meals.
Use for Storage: Foods can be prepared in advance, stored in the grill bag, placed in the fridge, cooler, or freezer and cooked only when you are ready to eat.

Anti-Leaking Seal Technology: The foil grilling bag features anti-leaking seal technology which enhances the strength of seams and prevents leaks. The bag can be placed directing on the grilling surface; window side up.
